judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same one-line production change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference, adds a comprehensive unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (even verifying that intermediate hooks are skipped via `recordingHooks`), and updates the specs, line numbers, and `CHANGELOG.md` to satisfy every acceptance criterion. However, the candidate also adds an unnecessary separate test file `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` and a `.lore/dod.md` artifact. Furthermore, the first test in `chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` declares `caughtError` and `afterSessionRan` variables and assigns to them inside hooks without ever reading or asserting on them, which will fail `npm run eslint --max-warnings 0` or `npm run typecheck` if `noUnusedLocals` / `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` is enabled.
